description: Thread-scaling measurements from Phase 4 (docs/validation-report.md, 'Phase 4 -- parallelism'), committed here as static JSON per CLAUDE.md sec.6 Phase 7's cost guardrails: the AWS demo's scaling chart is served from this file, never recomputed on request (a Lambda invocation cannot reproduce a controlled multi-core scaling measurement anyway).
methodology: bench/mc_bench.cpp, BM_MonteCarloEuropeanThreads, median of 5 runs, European call, 2e7 paths per run.
hardware: Apple M3 Pro, 5 performance + 6 efficiency cores, 11 physical/11 logical (no SMT)
